Blocks.Section: Step 1. Create and Configure a Customer App
SectionPath: Step 1. Create and Configure a Customer App
Blocks.Text: The Provisioning API allows you to create API keys for each of your customers. Ensure that you use proper customer names while provisioning as it will display on the consent screen (during OAuth flow) and within LinkedIn Recruiter. Please note that you need to store a unique API key for each of your customer tenant instances.

Blocks.Section: Step 1. Create and Configure a Customer App
SectionPath: Step 1. Create and Configure a Customer App
Blocks.Text: Once your app is configured, you may begin making API requests and testing the integration. All API requests require authorization.

Blocks.Section: Step 2. Display the Onboarding Configuration Plugin
SectionPath: Step 2. Display the Onboarding Configuration Plugin
Blocks.Text:
Use the Onboarding Configuration Plugin to allow your customers to request for different integration types.
Embed the Javascript code below to display the Onboarding Configuration plugin.

Blocks.Section: Step 2. Display the Onboarding Configuration Plugin
SectionPath: Step 2. Display the Onboarding Configuration Plugin
Blocks.Text:
The plugin loads based on the data-width and data-supported-bundled-integration-types attributes you specify
Use the data-supported-bundled-integration-types attribute to declare which integrations you support, a list of different integration types are displayed on the plugin as mentioned in data-supported-bundled-integration-types attribute
data-onintegrate attribute holds a callback function name that is invoked when the customer requests an integration within the plugin
When the customer requests an integration, Linkedin invokes this function in response and a response data is passed to the function parameter
The response data contains integrationContext, integrationType, and tenantType
Ensure that you store the values of integrationContext, integrationType, and tenantType as they will be used in the next step

SectionPath: Step 2. Display the Onboarding Configuration Plugin
Blocks.Text:
You only need to sync data with one organization URN. Sending data for multiple organization URNs in the sync APIs (under module 2) is not supported to avoid complexity.
When a customer activates a contract with the same organization, the payload includes only the new integrationType values (e.g., CRM_CSA_API), keeping all other values the same.
If a customer activates a contract with a different organization URN, you’ll receive the full payload as in Multiple Contract Support. In such cases, throw an error and advise the customer that only one organization can be active. They can contact the LinkedIn integrations support at ltsatsintegrations@linkedin.com for assistance.
For any subsequent contract payloads, repeat Steps 3–5 of the onboarding process, as done previously.

Blocks.Text: CRM Connect requires additional configuration to enable customers. Configurations are a set of key-value pairs which are defined for a specific integration. CRM Connect requires a callback URL for One Click Export to CRM functionalty to be configurated before the state of the customer's integration changes to ENABLED. You can define the callback URL as in the example below:
Here is an example request that sets the CALLBACK_URL key for the CRM_ONE_CLICK_EXPORT configuration type:
URL:

PUT https://api.linkedin.com/v2/atsIntegrations/integrationContext=urn:li:organization:{org_id}&integrationType=CRM_ONE_CLICK_EXPORT&tenantType=RECRUITER&dataProvider=ATS/configurations?ids=CALLBACK_URL
Headers:

Authorization: Bearer {token}
x-restli-method: batch_update
Request Body:

You can find more details on how to configure these keys, example requests, and definition of which configuration values are required for various integration types in our Integration Configuration docs.

Verify Customer Integrations API is used to find out the onboarding status of the integrations requested by customers using Step 2.
When a customer enables Apply with LinkedIn integration using Step 3, the onboarding status of that integration changes from Requested to Enabled. 
Customer integrations can have following three onboarding statuses:

Requested - the customer requested the integration. This is the status when customers have successfully completed Step 2
Partner Ready - the integration is ready to be enabled by the customer. It is not applicable for Apply with LinkedIn Integration type.
Enabled - the integration is set up and ready to use. This is the status when Step 3 is completed successfully

API Details
